svg.title: Community care booking · user-path storyboard
svg.desc: Keep preconditions, visible states, the main path, branches, and exceptions reviewable in one flow

g.font-family: PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The question is clear enough to start
The request is classified and completed
Available services and constraints are visible
Confirmation and a next entry point are
Persona: A caregiver arranging a care service · Goal: Find the next step and complete a booking in one session
Dashed and proposed paths are unverified; states, branches and exceptions come from the input and are never inferred from proximity.
Keep preconditions, visible states, the main path, branches, and exceptions reviewable in one flow
Cross-industry simulated input · proposed branches and exceptions still need observation
